changelog:
Initial release of SASE Private Access (PA) Network Diagnosis Skill.

- Enables creation and querying of SASE Private Access network diagnosis tasks to troubleshoot connectivity issues.
- Supports both FullLink (endpoint to origin) and Application (POP to origin) diagnosis types.
- Details limitations and prerequisites, including required CLI version, authentication method, and RAM permissions.
- Provides clear CLI invocation rules and mandatory parameter confirmation steps.
- Includes explicit workflow for AI-mode management during task execution.
- CLI actions: create-pa-diagnosis-task, get-pa-diagnosis-task, and list-user-devices.
